sequenceLimits.sourceFrameSets: Each ENV_Rxx pack references 24 frames across three 8-frame motifs. This review visually sampled representative frames only, not all 120 PNGs. Samples are 128x128 transparent canvases with very sparse glints/particles; intermittent fully transparent frames in ENV_R03_03/ENV_R04_03/ENV_R05_03 were measured previously and may be intentional blink gaps, not a proven defect.
sequenceLimits.runtimeEvidence: R02/R04/R05 effect contact sheets and R03 battle screenshot show effects in live battle scenes; R01 current view is postbattle forest screen, and the R145 receipt proves battle events/render snapshots but does not bind a viewed R01 effect frame.
sequenceLimits.noDefect: No concrete malformed/clipped ambient or VFX sprite was proven. These ten units remain candidate sequences; viewed screens do not qualify every effect identity/frame/timing.

R145R01Trace.scope: Six R01 real battles on older source snapshot; useful event trace, not current R373 visual acceptance.

R373VsR083.reuseDecision: R083/R145 evidence can be used as historical references, but exact source/resource parity is not established; do not count those as R373 current-source motion acceptance.

nextNativeBatch.recommendedFirstBatch: R373 ordinary-native event/render check for the 14 enemy encounters without newer ordinary-native evidence: E_R02_01, E_R02_03, E_R02_04, E_R03_02, E_R03_03, E_R03_04, E_R04_02, E_R04_03, E_R04_04, B_R02_A, B_R02_B, B_R03_A, B_R03_B, B_R04_A.
nextNativeBatch.reason: R366 ledger has newer ordinary native evidence for 10/30 enemies. R083 has all 30 x 7 isolated/requested-state captures but is CAPTURED_REQUIRES_HOST_AND_VISUAL_REVIEW and does not show organic transitions. R145 has real event/render traces for six R01 encounters but is an older app snapshot; R373 has source differences in EnemyMotion, LivingScene, and BattlePlayback and 1922 resources vs R083 1913, so old frame evidence cannot stand in for R373.
nextNativeBatch.currentEvidenceGap: For the 14 targets above, no newer ordinary fight screen/video is registered in R366; only R083 per-state requests/movies exist. For the other 16, screenshots/traces are partial, not state-by-state current-build acceptance. R145 actually observed all seven states for E_R01_01 and E_R01_04; it missed recover for E_R01_02, E_R01_03, B_R01_A, B_R01_B. All six R145 cases are still old-source evidence, not current R373 acceptance.
nextNativeBatch.procedure: On the already-installed R373 app, use ordinary encounter UI only; do not inject states or seed/economy data. Per encounter, retain start/result receipt and normal battle_art receipt, and one continuous screen recording through natural telegraph→execution→hit→resolve when those occur. If a state does not occur naturally, mark it unobserved. Stop for any target the ordinary UI cannot reach; no forced unlock. The normal battle_art snapshot is endpoint evidence only; the video is needed to inspect temporal appearance.
nextNativeBatch.observerLimit: R145 is compiled in R373 but its request parser accepts only six R01 IDs and requires --qa-isolated, --qa-enemy-event-render-trace-r145, and a UUID save key. R373 is a Release STANDARD_PLAY_R169 build. This review did not establish that those QA arguments are launch-compatible; do not rely on R145 for this batch without root preflight. Existing no-flag battle_art records geometry/effects/enemyPresentation at end but not per-event state timing.
nextNativeBatch.expectedBound: One batch: 14 encounters, <=600 s wall time, <=500 MB total outputs; at most 14 short native clips (target 10–13 s each where battle duration permits) plus existing compact battle/art receipts. At ~20 Mb/s observed R145 video rates, 14 x 12 s is ~420 MB; treat this as a hard output ceiling, not an estimate of exact compression. No new build/resource changes or video copies.
nextNativeBatch.coverageEffect: Closes direct ordinary-screen/video observation for the largest unrepresented 14 IDs if reachable. It will not establish all30 final quality or exact hidden event-to-frame causality where R145 is unavailable; a broader per-event observer would require a separate source/build step.
